rules_text.stop: Structural stop clamped to 3%-8% below the fill
rules_text.exit: First close below the 50-day SMA (21-day EMA once a close is 20%+ above the fill)
rules_text.entry: Buy stop at the pivot (limit +3%), valid 5 sessions; no fill on an earnings-reaction session

idle_cash.rule_text: Idle cash: held in SPY while SPY is above its 200-day SMA (to cash below -3%, back above +3%)
idle_cash.note: 2026-10 study: parking idle cash in SPY while SPY is above its 200-day SMA (3% band) raised the walk-forward record of the selection procedure from 8.6% to 10.8-12.2%/yr (2010-2026; SPY 12.0%; the range depends on when SPY is sold to fund a fill) and F6b 2007-2026 from 11.9% to 14.7-16.0%/yr with about the same max drawdown (22-23%). Bands of 1-5% gave similar results.

spy.label: Uptrend
spy.meaning: Healthy trend, historically the best balance of risk and reward: SPY was higher 3 months later about 3 times in 4, and 10% drops were rare (about 1 in 13).

breadth.label: Mixed
breadth.meaning: No clear direction; money is rotating between sectors.

context.note: Display only (never changes buy rules). Calibrated 2026-10-06 on SPY and breadth (% of liquid US stocks above their 50-day SMA), Oct 2005 - Oct 2026 (5,273 sessions): SPY's return and worst drawdown over the next 1 and 3 months by state. Odds are rough: overlapping windows, few independent episodes at the extremes.
